task: A process supervisor with restart-on-crash, exponential backoff, crash-loop detection and graceful stop, and its test.

criteria.text: register(name, cmd) and start_all() launch the registered commands as child processes.
A child exiting with a non-zero code is restarted after an exponential backoff of 1 s, 2 s, 4 s, ... capped at 30 s; a child exiting with code 0 is not restarted.
A child that crashes 5 times within 60 seconds is marked failed and no longer restarted (crashes are counted in a 60-second window).
stop_all() sends SIGTERM (terminate), waits up to 5 s, then SIGKILL (kill) for children still running.
The test uses a child script that crashes 3 times then succeeds (keeping its count outside the process, e.g. in a file), and verifies the restarts and the backoff delays (real or scaled time).

reference: Backoff delay for the k-th consecutive crash: min(30, 2**(k-1)) s. Crash-loop: 5 crashes whose timestamps fall in a 60 s window -> failed. Stop: terminate(), wait(5), kill().
